languageQuestions.title: Language
languageQuestions.intro: Explore frequently asked questions about the Fulfulde language, its grammar, usage and unique features.
languageQuestions.q1: What is the difference between Pulaar and Fulfulde?
languageQuestions.a1: Pulaar and Fulfulde refer to the same language, spoken by the Fulɓe (Fula people). Pulaar is the name used primarily in West Africa (Senegal, Mauritania, Guinea), while Fulfulde is the generic term encompassing all dialectal variants across Africa.
languageQuestions.a2: Fulfulde is spoken by approximately 40 to 50 million people across Africa, from Senegal to Sudan. It is one of the most widespread languages on the African continent.
languageQuestions.q3: What alphabet is used to write Fulfulde?
languageQuestions.a3: Fulfulde is primarily written in the Latin alphabet with special characters (ɓ, ɗ, ŋ, ƴ, ɲ, ñ). The Arabic alphabet (Ajami) is also traditionally used. Goomu Fulo & Wiɗto uses the standardized Latin alphabet.
languageQuestions.q4: What are noun classes in Fulfulde?
languageQuestions.a4: Fulfulde has a unique system of noun classes (about 25) that determine grammatical agreements. Each noun belongs to a class that influences pronouns, adjectives and verb forms. This is one of the most distinctive features of the language.
languageQuestions.q5: How does conjugation work in Fulfulde?
languageQuestions.a5: Conjugation in Fulfulde is rich and complex. Verbs change form according to tense, aspect, voice (active, passive, middle) and subject. The verbal system also includes extensions that modify the meaning of verbs (causative, reciprocal, intensive, etc.).
languageQuestions.a6: Several resources exist: university courses, Fula cultural associations, and online tools like the Goomu Fulo & Wiɗto dictionary. Our site aims to facilitate the learning and preservation of this language.

terminology.title: Fulfulde
terminology.intro: Terminology aims to create and standardize technical and scientific terms in Fulfulde for modern fields of knowledge.
terminology.whyText: For a language to remain alive and relevant, it must be able to express the realities of the modern world. Terminological creation allows Fulfulde to adapt to scientific, technological and administrative domains.
terminology.methodText: Goomu Fulo & Wiɗto follows a rigorous approach to creating new terms: studying existing roots, morphological derivation, adapted borrowing, and validation by speakers.
terminology.domScienceDesc: Terms for mathematics, physics, biology, computer science and natural sciences.
terminology.domSocietyDesc: Legal, administrative and social science vocabulary adapted to Fulfulde.
terminology.domHealthDesc: Medical and health terminology for better communication in healthcare settings.
terminology.domEduDesc: Pedagogical terms to support teaching in the Fulfulde language.
terminology.exploreText: Browse our dictionary to discover specialized terms in each domain.

privacy.subtitle: How we protect your personal data on goomufulo.com
privacy.intro: At Goomu Fulo Wiɗto, protecting your personal data is a priority. This privacy policy transparently describes what data we collect, why we use it and how we protect it. We commit to respecting your privacy and never using your information for commercial or advertising purposes.

s1.title: Data Controller

s1.name: Organization

s2.title: Data Collected
s2.p1: We collect different categories of data depending on your use of the platform:
s2.sub1p: When creating your account, we collect:
s2.sub1l2: Your email address (for authentication and essential communications)
s2.sub1l3: Your password (stored encrypted, never in plain text)
s2.sub2p: If you choose to sign in via Google OAuth, we receive:
s2.sub3p: When using our contact form, we collect:
s2.sub4p: During your browsing, certain technical data is automatically collected:

s3.title: Processing Purposes
s3.p1: Your data is used exclusively for the following purposes:
s3.l1: Managing your user account and secure authentication
s3.l2: Personalizing your experience (display language, visual theme)
s3.l3: Managing roles and permissions (administrator, moderator, member)
s3.l4: Processing messages sent through the contact form
s3.l5: Sending email invitations to join the contribution team
s3.l6: Continuous improvement of the platform and its linguistic content
s3.l7: Ensuring the security and proper technical operation of the site

s4.title: Legal Basis
s4.p1: The processing of your data is based on the following legal grounds:
s4.l1d: You consent to the processing of your data when creating your account or sending a contact message.
s4.l2d: Processing is necessary to provide the learning service and linguistic tools you subscribed to by registering.
s4.l3d: Securing the platform and improving user experience constitute a legitimate interest of Goomu Fulo Wiɗto.

s5.title: Data Retention
s5.p1: Your data is retained for the following periods:
s5.l1: Account data: retained as long as your account is active. After account deletion, your data is erased within 30 days.
s5.l2: Contact messages: retained for a maximum of 12 months after processing your request.
s5.l3: Technical data (cookies, preferences): session duration or until you change your preferences.
s5.p2: Validated linguistic contributions (translations, definitions) are permanently retained in the dictionary, even after contributor account deletion, as they are an integral part of the collective linguistic heritage.

s6.title: Data Sharing
s6.p1: Goomu Fulo Wiɗto never sells, rents or shares your personal data with third parties for commercial or advertising purposes.
s6.highlight: Your data is never sold, rented or shared for commercial purposes. Never.
s6.p2: Your data may only be shared in the following cases:
s6.l1: Technical host (Contabo): strictly within the scope of data hosting on servers
s6.l2: Google: only if you chose Google OAuth login, limited to authentication data
s6.l3: Legal obligation: if required by law (judicial requisition, regulatory obligation)

s7.title: Data Security
s7.p1: We implement robust technical and organizational measures to protect your data:
s7.l1: Encrypted communications via HTTPS/TLS (SSL certificate managed by Cloudflare)
s7.l2: Passwords hashed with bcrypt algorithm (never stored in plain text)
s7.l3: JWT token authentication with automatic expiration
s7.l4: Protection against common attacks (SQL injection, XSS, CSRF)
s7.l5: Data access restricted to authorized administrators only
s7.p2: Despite these measures, no system is infallible. In case of a data breach, we commit to notifying affected users as soon as possible.

s8.title: Your Rights
s8.p1: Under applicable data protection legislation, you have the following rights:
s8.l1d: You may request to know what data we hold about you.
s8.l2d: You may request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
s8.l3d: You may request deletion of your personal data and account.
s8.l4d: You may object to the processing of your data on legitimate grounds.
s8.l5d: You may request to receive your data in a structured, commonly used format.
s8.l6d: You may request restriction of processing of your data in certain circumstances.
s8.p2: To exercise your rights, contact us at contact@goomufulowidto.org. We will respond within 30 days. You may also modify or delete your account directly from your profile settings.

s9.title: Cookies
s9.p1: The site goomufulo.com exclusively uses technical cookies necessary for platform operation. We do not use any advertising, tracking or behavioral analysis cookies.
s9.sub1l1d: Keeps your login session active. Automatically expired for security reasons.
s9.sub1l2d: Saves your language choice (fr/en/ff) and theme (light/dark) to enhance your experience.
s9.sub2p: You can configure your browser to refuse cookies. However, refusing technical cookies may prevent proper site operation (login impossible, preferences not saved).

s10.title: Protection of Minors
s10.p1: The site goomufulo.com is an educational platform with a cultural purpose, accessible to all audiences. Learning the Fulfulde language is open without age restriction.
s10.p2: However, creating a user account by a minor under 16 years of age requires the consent of a parent or legal guardian. If you are a parent and find that your child has registered without your consent, contact us so we can proceed with account deletion.

s11.title: Changes to This Policy
s11.p1: We reserve the right to modify this privacy policy at any time. Changes will take effect upon publication on this page.
s11.p2: In case of substantial modifications affecting your rights or how your data is processed, we will inform you through a visible notification on the site. The last update date is indicated at the top of this page.
